items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I happened to run into Mary Lou Williams, who I knew very well in Memphis. And she told me to go by and see Ed Hall at Cafe Society uptown... she had me to come and speak to Ed Hall. Sure enough, I did, and so I got a job there

ctx.x: When you got out of the service -- you didn't see any action, as far as bang-bang, boom-boom.

When I got out of the service, I happened to run into Mary Lou Williams, who I knew very well in Memphis. And she told me to go by and see Ed Hall at Cafe Society uptown. And that's when I started peeping through the (unintelligible) cracks on the outside every night, to see what drummer was doing. Trap Hull from Brooklyn, playing good.
